items.title: Jake Hanna interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Peter and — Chad and Jeremy, Peter and Gordon. [INTERVIEWEE] Peter and Gordon. Oh, man, I mean they were awful.

ctx.x: know. Poor Quincy. He’s dealt with these fools for years. And Phil Ramone is in with them too. You know he’s the best sound engineer there is. I don’t know what he’s doing with these guys. Making a lot of money I guess. But he did a lot of great stuff with Woody you know. Great stuff. He’s a hell of a nice guy too. But yeah, it was awful that stuff they were doing. And that’s what used to appear on the show all the time. Monty Rock III. The Lovin’ Spoonful. And what was a couple of others. Peter and something or…
Peter and — Chad and Jeremy, Peter and Gordon.
Peter and Gordon. Oh, man, I mean they were awful.
